text:
- **Owner questions:** An ask-tool question can now be answered on the site or in chat, and the first answer wins. Questions now close only from hook events, and pm no longer reads transcripts or rollouts for them.
- **CI and test stability:** The AGENTS.md check grades diffs on pull requests and runs in full daily on main. Reruns now give the same verdict, and the Go test suite passes on every run.
- **pm setup:** This repo now runs a newer pm release, and Claude Code auto memory is off here. pm no longer installs a git hook or owns `core.hooksPath`; new worktrees are set up at session start.
- **Record layer:** The record-layer design is agreed, and the owner chose Model A. Work started on the published view and per-version pages on the site.
